node.label: hereditary spastic paraplegia 15
node.definition: Autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 15 is a complex form of hereditary spastic paraplegia characterized by a childhood to adulthood onset of slowly progressive lower limb spasticity (resulting in gait disturbance, extensor plantar responses and decreased vibration sense) associated with mild intellectual disability, mild cerebellar ataxia, peripheral neuropathy (with distal upper limb amyotrophy) and retinal degeneration. Thin corpus callosum is a common imaging finding.
synonyms: ZFYVE26 autosomal recessive complex spastic paraplegia
autosomal recessive complex spastic paraplegia caused by mutation in ZFYVE26
recessive spastic paraplegia with retinal degeneration
